summary: All ten findings verified against the code and fixed. WFP-R1 (blocker): Public never shows a past step any more: entering the Public map view stops Play and puts the handle back at now (floodPlayback.ts leavePlaybackForPublic on a useWorkspace subscription; Forensic, which keeps the preset it came from, is not Public), and the map, legend and point card read the handle through handleFor / useFloodHandleMs, which is always now in Public. WFP-R2 (blocker): the readout and the point card judge a spot by exactly what the map draws at the handle: the timeline's NWS versions (productsAtHandle; checkPoint takes them as `shown`), the pass at the handle and its own class sampler (useSatClassAt(lon, lat, satAt)), and no satellite area figure of another day. WFP-R3 (major): at a past step the row's 'NWS · n' button lists each NWS version the map draws with its event and issuer verbatim, its own issue and end times in its own zone, its headline, a link, and for IEM copies the 'Archived copy (Iowa Environmental Mesonet)' tag; Command's foot credits add the IEM archive's credit while one of its copies is drawn. WFP-R4..R10: credits follow the pass on the map; phones keep the image's date on a second row line; 'now' layers say so on their chips and in the row; ticks fall back to the live answer when the timeline's products block is down; the tooltip follows a changing data-tip; 'Shown:' replaces 'Map:'; the App-import test has a 20 s limit.

findings.verified: Real: map/floodController.ts syncAreas passed useFlood.cursorMs to satelliteAtHandle / warningsAtHandle in every chrome, FloodLegend's useSatelliteAtHandle read the same handle, and nothing reset it when Public came on screen (the cursor is only set by the chart). Reproduced on Calcasieu in the old build per the finding.
findings.fix: state/floodTimelineData.ts: isPublicView (workspace 'map' and preset 'public'), handleFor(publicView, cursorMs) (null in Public), useFloodHandleMs(); useSatelliteAtHandle uses it. ui/timeline/floodPlayback.ts: leavePlaybackForPublic() on a useWorkspace subscription when the Public map view comes on screen (Play off, axis back to 72 h, cursor null); Forensic with the Public preset keeps its dock's handle. map/floodController.ts syncAreas uses handleFor(isPublicView(...), cursorMs). location/FloodPointCard.tsx uses useFloodHandleMs. Tests: floodAreaLayers.test.ts (a past handle in Public draws the route's own image and the live products; Command and Forensic follow the handle), floodPlayback.test.ts (entering Public resets; Forensic with the Public preset does not).

findings.verified: Real: location/FloodReadout.tsx and FloodPointCard.tsx passed the live alerts answer and off.satellite to checkPoint, which applied productsShown on the live answer (the Calcasieu EXT, onset Nov 5 06:00Z, is not in effect at the Nov 4 22:30Z step) and named the route's Oct 29 pass at the Oct 25 step; AreaRows used off.satellite's stats.
findings.fix: map/floodAreaLayers.ts productsAtHandle(live, liveAlerts, tl, cursorMs, nowMs) (productsAt + the zones of its source; warningsAtHandle draws it). location/floodCheck.ts FloodPointInput.shown (declared edit): the products already picked at the handle, else productsShown as before. Readout PointLayers and point card FloodViewBlock: useProductsAtHandle (alerts, shown, zones; alertsStatus 'available' for the timeline's block), satellite = useSatelliteAtHandle(...), satClass = useSatClassAt(lon, lat, satAt) (official/floodHooks.ts, declared edit: optional third argument), lineTag with the pass's answer. AreaRows: areaFigures(fim, satAt) (a past pass has stats null: no figure). Test: floodAreaLayers.test.ts (a timeline-only archived version covers the spot at a past cursor: 'Inside the NWS Flood Warning area (until …)', never NOTHING_COVERS; the satellite line names the pass at the handle; at now the live EXT reads 'starting …').

findings.verified: Real: no playback code read products.archive_source or ARCHIVED_COPY; the step label had no issuer, end time or link; the foot credits had no IEM line.
findings.fix: ui/timeline/HydrographPlayback.tsx: at a past step with the timeline's versions drawn, 'NWS · n' (.hg-nws-btn) opens a popover 'NWS products on the map at this time' listing each version (NwsVersion): event and sender_name inside data-verbatim, 'issued … · until …' in the product's own zone, the headline verbatim, ARCHIVED_COPY for an IEM copy, a link ('NWS product' / 'Archived copy of the NWS product'), PLAYBACK.nwsNote and the archive's credit with its terms link. In Command and in Forensic's dock. map/floodAreaLayers.ts archiveCreditAtHandle(r, tl). ui/shell/CommandFloodChrome.tsx (declared edit) FloodLayerFootCredits adds the archive's credit while the warning layer draws an archived copy. Tests: HydrographPlayback.test.ts (button only at a past step with versions drawn; NwsVersion's verbatim parts, own times, link, archived tag), floodAreaLayers.test.ts (credit only while an archived copy is drawn).

known_issues: Forensic's own foot credits (web-forensic-flood-3d's files) do not add the IEM archive's credit while the 3D warning lines draw archived versions; the dock's 'NWS · n' list carries it (tag, link and credit).
Entering Public puts the handle back at now, so a step chosen in Command is not kept when the user returns to Command from Public (Forensic keeps it).
On phones the second row line is one line with an ellipsis: the image's date and age always fit; a long 'Now: …' list after them can be cut (its full text is in the line's title).
The 'NWS · n' list shows only the timeline's versions at a past step; at now 'Official now' lists the products as before.
